بُهْرَةٌ Plain, or even, or soft, land or ground: or a wide tract of land between mountains. (L.) ―
-b2- See also بُهْرٌ, in two places. ―
-b3- The middle (S, A, K) of a valley, and of the night, and of a horse, (S, K,) and of a camel's saddle, (TA,) and of a ring, (K,) or of a thing. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
